lines: Fees at registration offices may change: the fee table under the Registration Act, 1908 has been amended.
An erratum corrects an earlier notification amending the Tamil Nadu Legal Metrology (Enforcement) Rules, 2011, under the Labour Welfare and Skill Development Department.
The Madras High Court judgment in Election Petition No.36 of 2026 has been published by the Public (Elections) Department.
Temple staff take note: service rules for Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments employees, set in 2020, have been amended.
The Human Resources Management Department issued a notification under the Right to Information Act, 2005.
Ordinary items: a land reforms notification was modified, and routine name-change notices by individuals were published.
